title: North Country National Scenic Trail: Trail Alerts
summary: Trail closures are reported to the North Country Trail Association. Go to their Trail Alerts page for the latest information.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore: Private Inholdings: Sand & Rocky Islands
summary: There are privately occupied residences and docks on the southeast corner of Sand Island, as well as just north of Group Site A on Rocky Island. These areas are closed to the public. Please respect their privacy and do not trespass in these locations.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore: Bear Alert
summary: Black bears inhabit many of the Apostle Islands. Follow safety guidelines: store food and scented items properly, hike in groups, stay attentive, and make noises if you encounter a bear in a visitor area.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore: Construction Activity at Little Sand Bay; Boat and Kayak Access Maintained
summary: Construction for the Little Sand Bay Marina Rehabilitation Project begins May 1. The Town of Russell boat launch and the NPS kayak beach will remain open, with short detours around work areas. Expect reduced parking, delays, and increased noise. The Little Sand Bay Visitor Center will be closed in 2026 due to construction.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore: Ongoing Closure Notices
summary: Devils Island dock and campsites and West Bay Club on Sand Island are closed. These closures affect only a small portion of the Lakeshore. Enjoy your visit.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore: Stockton Island Trail Access
summary: The trail between Presque Isle Bay and Quarry Bay on Stockton Island is open, but a footbridge on the western portion of the trail was washed out in a 2024 storm. Visitors must wade through shallow water or take an alternate route.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore: Hunting Season Safety
summary: Hunting is allowed in parts of Apostle Islands National Lakeshore from mid-September through early January. Wear blaze orange to stay visible and keep pets leashed and in bright vests. Make noise while hiking so others can hear you. Stay aware and enjoy a safe visit. Click the link below for more information on hunting and trapping in the Lakeshore.

title: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore
summary: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore, located at the northern tip of Wisconsin's Bayfield Peninsula, features 21 stunning islands, a scenic 12-mile shoreline along Lake Superior, and is located within the ancestral homeland of the Ojibwe people. Established in 1970, the park showcases picturesque sea caves, sandy beaches, and the largest collection of lighthouses in the National Park system.

title: North Country National Scenic Trail
summary: Come to the North Country. Trek the hills and valleys. Stand on the shores of lakes & streams from glaciers 10,000 years before. From North Dakota to Vermont, adventure is never far away.
